Stage 2 of 4Practice

Try getting it back and working with it while mistakes are still useful. This is part of learning, not a test. Pick the ones that suit you.

No points

  • Try It From Memory

    Do not look anything up yet. See what your brain can produce. What you forget tells you what needs another pass.

  • Draw it

    A blank canvas. Mechanism, sequence, loop. Produce it from nothing, then check it.

  • Recall cards

    Spaced recall with the full reason every answer is right or wrong.

  • Book problems

    Problems you have not seen. Predict, commit, then check.

  • All of it on one sheet

    Every practice item for the week on one printable page.
